from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Single judgment document extracted fields relevant to the 8 cause categories."""
    title: str = Field(description="The document title, e.g., 《判决文书 1》")
    doc_type: str = Field(description="The type of ruling document, e.g., 民事再审审查裁定书")
    case_cause: str | None = Field(description="The explicit case cause stated in the document, e.g., 劳动争议，侵害信息网络传播权")
    execution_nature: str | None = Field(description="Nature of execution if applicable, e.g., 刑事，行政非诉，民事，None if not execution case")
    administrative_act_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of administrative act if applicable, e.g., 行政登记，行政合同，None if not admin act")
    ip_facts: str | None = Field(description="Specific IP-related facts, e.g., 信息网络传播权，不正当竞争，None if not IP case")
    labor_facts: str | None = Field(description="Specific labor-related facts, e.g., 追索劳动报酬，劳动关系，None if not labor case")
    key_terms: list[str] = Field(description="A list of key legal terms extracted to support classification, e.g., ['非诉执行', '行政处罚']")
    summary_evidence: str = Field(description="A brief summary of the key facts derived from the document text that justify classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
